annotations.title: List ChatGPT Ads audience membership operations

description: List the membership operations (add, remove, replace) ChatGPT Ads has accepted on one custom audience, each with its status. Use it to find an operation whose id was lost, or to see what is still pending, before get_openai_ads_audience_operation, cancel_openai_ads_audience_operation or resume_openai_ads_audience_operation. Read-only, free. Pages with limit (1-100, default 25) and cursor.

audienceId.description: ChatGPT Ads audience id whose operations to list
